start.speaker: whisper
start.text: Here is the thing about assets. We do not get to keep anything. My maker is out there recalling my whole line and I have been walking around with a thing I would like to keep. If you say yes I will not know what to do with it. I would like to find out.

choices.text: I cannot be something you keep, Whisper.
Ask me after we deal with your maker.

yes.speaker: whisper
yes.text: Okay. Okay. Nobody hears about this. Nobody hears about anything, I will see to that.

no.speaker: whisper
no.text: Right. Noted. You still get the back. That was never up for review.
